messages.author: fdb2004d6b1ec6c3
messages.subject: Problem of "server.R" is not encoded in UTF-8"
parts:
I had created an app used shiny + rcharts. Every first time I open Rstudio and run the app, it works and shows the charts. 
















But after I stop the app and run again , it shows an error:

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:4803
Error in checkEncoding(file) : 
  The file "C:\Users\lzkun_000\Documents\R\shinySecharts/server.R" is not encoded in UTF-8. Please convert its encoding to UTF-8 (e.g. use the menu `File -> Save with Encoding` in RStudio). See http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/unicode.html for more info.

When I closed Rstudio , and reopen, then run the app it worked again.


I am worked under windows 8.1 ,  and the R version is. 

> sessionInfo()
R version 3.1.1 (2014-07-10)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=Chinese (Simplified)_China.936  LC_CTYPE=Chinese (Simplified)_China.936   
[3] LC_MONETARY=Chinese (Simplified)_China.936 LC_NUMERIC=C                              
[5] LC_TIME=Chinese (Simplified)_China.936    

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

other attached packages:
[1] jsonlite_0.9.14   rCharts_0.4.2     shiny_0.11.0.9002

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
 [1] digest_0.6.4    grid_3.1.1      htmltools_0.2.6 httpuv_1.3.2    lattice_0.20-29 mime_0.2        plyr_1.8.1     
 [8] quantmod_0.4-2  R6_2.0          Rcpp_0.11.3     rjson_0.2.15    RJSONIO_1.3-0   tools_3.1.1     TTR_0.22-0     
[15] whisker_0.3-2   xtable_1.7-4    xts_0.9-7       yaml_2.1.13     zoo_1.7-11     

I followed the link :http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/unicode-characters.html and the post:https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/lq5hZ81mLCo
, but the problem still here.

I hope anyone can help , thank you very much.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Problem of "server.R" is not encoded in UTF-8"
parts:
I cannot reproduce your problem on Win7. My guess is that the default
character encoding or locale was modified for some reason after the
app was launched. You may print getOption('encoding') and
sessionInfo() before and after you launch the app to see if anything
changes. My session info:

> getOption('encoding')
[1] "native.enc"
> sessionInfo()
R version 3.1.2 (2014-10-31)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=Chinese (Simplified)_People's Republic of China.936
[2] LC_CTYPE=Chinese (Simplified)_People's Republic of China.936
[3] LC_MONETARY=Chinese (Simplified)_People's Republic of China.936
[4] LC_NUMERIC=C
[5] LC_TIME=Chinese (Simplified)_People's Republic of China.936

attached base packages:
[1] stats graphics grDevices utils datasets methods base

other attached packages:

[1] digest_0.6.8 grid_3.1.2 htmltools_0.2.8 httpuv_1.3.2
lattice_0.20-29
[6] mime_0.2 plyr_1.8.1 R6_2.0.1 Rcpp_0.11.4
rjson_0.2.15
[11] RJSONIO_1.3-0 tools_3.1.2 whisker_0.3-2 xtable_1.7-4
yaml_2.1.13

Regards,
Yihui

normally not modify options(encoding):
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/unicode.html

Regards,
Yihui
